facts.content: Patient has a 3-day worsening headache, mainly around the right eye.
facts.source_text: CC: 3-day worsening HA, mainly around R eye

facts.content: The headache is dull at baseline with intermittent sharp pain and is constantly present with an 8/10 pain level.
facts.source_text: Dull baseline → intermittent sharp; constant presence; 8/10 pain

facts.content: Patient experiences photophobia and 'shooting lights' at headache onset.
Patient reports no vision loss, weakness, speech difficulty, neck stiffness, fever, rash, or head trauma.
facts.source_text: no vision loss, weakness, speech difficulty, neck stiffness, fever, rash, head trauma

facts.content: Tried ibuprofen 3 tablets per day for 2 days with minimal relief; prior headaches resolved with ibuprofen.
facts.source_text: Tried ibuprofen 3 tabs/day ×2 d → minimal relief; prior HAs resolved w/ ibuprofen

facts.content: No past medical or surgical history reported.
Patient works an IT job with screen exposure, has mild work stress, wears glasses, lives with three housemates, and is a social smoker and drinker.
facts.source_text: IT job, screen exposure; mild work stress; wears glasses; lives w/ 3 housemates; social smoker & etOH

facts.content: Probable migraine-type headache due to family predisposition, photophobia, poor response to low-dose NSAID, and no neurological deficits.
facts.source_text: Probable migraine-type HA—family predisposition, photophobia, poor response to low-dose NSAID, no neuro deficits

facts.content: Optimize NSAID: ibuprofen up to 400 mg, 2 tablets three times a day with food.
facts.source_text: Optimize NSAID: ibuprofen up to 400 mg 2 tabs TID w/ food

facts.content: Consider prescribing naproxen and adding paracetamol or codeine as needed for breakthrough pain.
facts.source_text: Consider Rx naproxen; add paracetamol ± codeine PRN for breakthrough pain

facts.content: Educate on headache diary to identify triggers.
facts.source_text: Educate on HA diary to identify triggers

facts.content: Safety net advice: return immediately for visual changes, neurological deficits, or worsening pain.
facts.source_text: Safety net: return immediately for visual changes, neuro deficits, worsening pain

facts.content: Encourage routine eye exam for possible strain.
facts.source_text: Encourage routine eye exam for possible strain

facts.content: Follow-up in 1–2 weeks to discuss prophylaxis if headaches recur.
